templates.why_chosen: Clients cloud fanning into a primary and two backups, with an inside legend for GET vs PUT/DEL and a small configuration table.
templates.what_to_learn: A replicated-store figure needs three things: a client source, one expanded server, and collapsed peers; the legend distinguishes operation classes by line style.

templates.why_chosen: Circled numbers on Server 1 trace a write crossing from local per-thread logs to RDMA-replicated backup logs on Server 2 and Server 3, with a shard-map table (CM) above as the routing tier clients consult.
templates.what_to_learn: Number the write path only where it crosses a machine boundary (local append versus RDMA replication to the backup tier), and draw the routing/shard-map table as a small inset table above the tier stack rather than another full box, since compact tabular metadata reads faster there.
